name: io.github.tonyyang0504/teams-mcp
description: Microsoft Teams (messaging): me, send, list_inbound, get_thread, reply, mark_read. Every tool maps t

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the app registration ('Only required for web apps'); leave empty for a public client. Sent in the form body of POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent including offline_access and the delegated scopes User.Read Chat.ReadWrite ChatMessage.Send ChannelMessage.Send ChannelMessage.Read.All (work or school accounts only; personal accounts are 'Not supported'). Microsoft may return a new refresh token on every refresh; the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/<platform>.json (mode 0600).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_TEAM_ID
environmentVariables.description: Team id whose channel threads get_thread and reply use (GET /me/joinedTeams).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Entra object id of the signed-in user (GET /me → id); required by mark_read.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Tenant id of the signed-in user; required by mark_read.
